posts.title: A Practical System Design Framework
posts.description: I am starting a new series about system design. I would like to study the systems I deal with every day, or I am interested in. My goal is to understand how these systems work, why they are designed the way day are, and what trade-offs their creators had to make. In this first post, I am discussing what makes system design a durable skill, and presenting a simple method to get started with design.
